nights.title: SON MIEUX - 24 Hours – EU Album Tour
nights.name: Son Mieux
nights.extract: Son Mieux is a Dutch indie pop group from The Hague headed by Camiel Meiresonne.

nights.title: Elder Island - 2026
nights.name: Elder Island
nights.extract: Elder Island is an English musical trio from Bristol, formed in 2014. As of 2026, they have released three studio albums, three EPs, two remix albums, and numerous singles.

nights.title: Strangelove - The DEPECHE MODE Experience Black Celebration 2026
nights.name: Strangelove
nights.extract: Strangelove were an English alternative rock band, formed in Bristol in 1991 comprising singer Patrick Duff, guitarists Alex Lee & Julian Poole, bassist Joe Allen and John Langley on drums. They released two EPs and three albums before disbanding in 1998.

nights.title: Green Lung
nights.name: Green Lung
nights.extract: Green Lung is a British stoner/doom metal band formed in 2017 in London, currently signed to Nuclear Blast Records.
